study type: Retrospective analysis with ex vivo validation
cohort: Seventeen pregnant individuals (ten with term deliveries and seven with preterm deliveries with inflammation-related conditions) underwent in vivo diffusion basis spectrum imaging (DBSI) analysis.
finding: Distinct microstructural differences in cervical cellularity, collagen, and muscle fibers were found between term and preterm deliveries with inflammation-related conditions using DBSI, correlating significantly with delivery timing.
cross-section timing: In vivo analysis performed at 32 weeks of gestation.
gest_age: Study included term and preterm pregnancies; in vivo analysis performed at 32 weeks of gestation.
